<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/list_code_lists"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Every loaded code list with its version in use and previous version,
their code and active-code counts, the source (imported, or fetched by an
earlier build), when
and by whom, the AI flag, the notice, whether the list is damaged, and the
step and rows read of any running job (Requirement 12.3, 12.5). Empty until
an administrator adds a list (Requirement 11.1).

``jobs`` carries the latest job of each list that doesn't exist yet (a
first import being read or waiting to be confirmed), so the
page can show its progress and staged preview before the list is created.
